title: Lane lint and the shared action use one Playwright install script, and lane lint never downloads a browser.
ruling: Coordinator, 06:18 CST Nov 8, option a: one install script shared by the playwright-setup action and ci-job. Lane lint never downloads a browser (decision playwright-install-once).
